dict.string: AI chats in Workbench work with files on flash drives, SD cards and connected devices when you ask them to.
AI chats in Workbench work with files on network drives when you ask them to.
AI chats in Workbench work with files on your Desktop when you ask them to.
AI chats in Workbench work with files in your Documents folder when you ask them to.
AI chats in Workbench work with files in your Downloads folder when you ask them to.
Workbench connects to your phone and other computers on your Wi-Fi when you link them.
